title: Explain Stop-first recovery when inactive checkpoint debt accompanies a running local OFF turn
outcome: A session running an allowed fresh unmediated OFF turn with retained original checkpoint-report debt currently refuses kill/settings/project deletion as an administrative blocker before the usual stop flow. Its conflict message should identify Stop as the supported next action, without weakening live provider/accounting or original-debt exclusion.
acceptance: For retained inactive original-checkpoint report debt plus a running unmediated local OFF turn, administrative refusal gives an accurate supported Stop-first action, or uses the existing lifecycle to stop before a safe recheck; it never settles or erases the original debt.
A focused regression covers refusal while the local provider is active and supported progress after confirmed Stop, preserving immutable debt and all independent-duty fences.
